senses.gloss: pledge, mortgage; an object made a security without being placed in the possession of the pledgee, opp. to מַשְׁכּוֹן.—
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 96a:3">B. Kam. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>שווייה ניהליה א׳ וכ׳</he> he made it a mortgage by saying, ‘You can pay yourself only out of this thing’.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 11b:13">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>עשה עבדו א׳</he> if he mortgaged his slave; a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 8:6">Tosef. Shebi. VIII, 6</cite> <he>שטר שיש בו א׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="E00729"><he>הִפּוֹתִּקִי</he></cite>) a note (contract) containing a mortgage obligation.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:6">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>כתוב לי א׳ על וכ׳</he> give me a mortgage on thy field.—Pl. <he>אִפּוֹתִּיקָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 19a:18">B. Mets. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>דייתיקאות א׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>הפותיקו׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) wills, mortgage deeds &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:13">Tosef. Sabb. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:13">IX</cite>), 13 <he>שטרי דייתיקי וא׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>הפות׳</he>, read <he>והפ׳</he>).
